gen-amatic-sc-gf-duru-sans: Amatic SC draws a single wiry line with terminals that stop well short of the stem, like quick lettering on a napkin. And Duru Sans sits below as a plain sans, wide-mouthed and low-slung, with ascenders that barely announce themselves.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads dignified, with a gaping c and rounded, tall lowercase. Amatic SC earns its place when the words are big and brief, its handwritten diagonals as sturdy as its stems against that classic serif.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a text serif with a tall middle band, short ascenders and descenders, and a generous opening into the e. Over a longer passage it feels literary and unhurried, while Amatic SC above it keeps a pipe-like, rustic hand.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-fresca: Amatic SC has terminals that stop far from the stem, giving it a casual, pen-and-paper wobble. Fresca answers in sans-serif, with no calligraphic thinning, counters that stay open to the outside, and short ascenders above big bowls.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-funnel-sans:
Amatic SC squeezes out one steady, toothpaste-like line, quirky and rustic.

Funnel Sans takes over as a plain sans with tiny gaps above the x-height and a pried-open e, so the hand-lettered headline gets steady footing underneath.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a tall band of letters under short stalks, each e looking wide-eyed and contemporary. Amatic SC is best at round, unswelling bowls and a quirky hand, while Gafata, a sans-serif, is best at staying composed and professional.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-geist: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC lets its pen-and-paper terminals wander away from the stem. But Geist, a sans, keeps a quiet, level beat, with words that read as solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-georama: Approachable is the right word for Georama, and Amatic SC adds a quirky, rustic hand on top. Georama runs as a sans with bracelet-wide c shapes and barely rising capitals, so a longer stretch reads smoothly and unfussy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-gidole: Gidole holds a high midline and open, scissor-blade terminals. Its sans-serif strokes look drawn in neon tube, so a longer passage moves along cleanly under Amatic SC's quirky scrawl.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-glegoo: Amatic SC keeps one unmodulated line across every glyph. Glegoo, a text serif, brings big counters and wide, unclosed curves, so a longer passage feels refined and editorial beneath the handwriting.
